item.title: IDF's hands are tied against Hezbollah drone threat
item.description:
The Lebanese deadlock: Hezbollah continues to launch drones and unmanned aerial vehicles at IDF troops operating inside Lebanese territory and toward Israel's northern border, without the IDF having an effective answer.
